semiconductor_relevance: High — Tohoku-MicroTec specializes in advanced 3D/2.5D IC manufacturing, focusing on technologies critical for modern semiconductor applications.
summary: Tohoku-MicroTec Co., Ltd is a foundry that specializes in the manufacturing of advanced 3D/2.5D integrated circuits (ICs) and MEMS processes. They offer a comprehensive range of services from TSV design to prototyping and small volume production, catering to high-performance semiconductor applications.
capabilities: 3D-IC manufacturing with chip level to 12" wafer level integration
Prototyping services for Si interposers and micro-bump technology

regional_presence.Japan: Tohoku-MicroTec originated from Tohoku University and operates within Japan, leveraging local technological expertise.
